top_violation_types.title: HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - Not Listed (26 TAC §HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - No)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Regular care is being provided to 2 unrelated children.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §744.501(26))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There is no policy on how the operation will support the inclusion of special needs children in to their program.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors (26 TAC §744.501(25))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operational Policies did state if operation will administer unassigned epinephrine auto injectors.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Special Care Needs Statement (26 TAC §744.605(13))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children's files do not include the special needs documentation listed in this section.

top_violation_types.title: HRC42.041(a) - Illegal Operation - Not Licensed (26 TAC §HRC42.041(a) - Illegal Operation - Not L)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is operating prior to receiving their permit.

top_violation_types.title: Designating Director (26 TAC §744.201(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a designated site director.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Emergency Contact (26 TAC §744.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 3 children need emergency contact information for child admission form.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Water Activity Permission (26 TAC §744.605(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Four out of thirty three children files reviewed did not include whether the child can swim unassisted or not based on their water activity permission.
